description: The file contains a PHP class, Upload, within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Tool, which manages file upload, listing, download, and deletion functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class handling upload management functions such as viewing, listing, deleting, and downloading uploads in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main upload page with necessary data and UI components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the uploaded files list view with filtered and sorted data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of uploads based on filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected upload files both from the filesystem and database, with permission checks.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles file download for a specific upload identified by a code parameter.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload, including permission checks, filename validation, mime/type validation, and storing the file, returning JSON response with success or error.
